src.notes:
Recommended Mac shape: hybrid. Use Docker only for the bus plane: bloodbank-nats, nats-init, dapr-placement, the daprd sidecars, ntfy-router and (later) turn-enricher. Containers earn their place here because the daprd sidecars resolve `nats` by container DNS, the images are multi-arch, and stream state is a single volume. Everything on the agent hot path or touching the host filesystem runs natively under launchd: hook-hub, artifact-sidecar/projector, and the Hermes gateway plugin. All services in the repo are Python and mostly stdlib; nats-py is the only real dependency for the host services.

Concrete gotchas found:
(1) Two compose files claim container_name bloodbank-nats. Live state comes from 33god-platform/compose.yaml; `mise run up` in bloodbank targets the stale compose/docker-compose.yml. Use the platform compose only.
(2) Pin bloodbank to origin/main cf28455. The 33GOD parent pins db9fd9f, 3 commits behind, and the live ntfy-router runs feature-branch 68485b9 (TOLT).
(3) The committed generated per-CLI hook configs hardcode /home/delorenj/.agents/hooks/bb-hook (sync.py:292). Fix this before Damian runs hooks:deploy, or the two machines will keep rewriting each other's paths in the repo.
(4) hub.py needs Python 3.11 or newer (tomllib). macOS /usr/bin/python3 is 3.9, and launchd's PATH lacks mise shims, so set an absolute interpreter, PATH, BB_HOOK_SOCKET, HOOK_HUB_HTTP_PORT=8685 and BLOODBANK_ASM=false in the plist.
(5) Trim handlers.toml for Damian to a minimal set: skill-reminder, candystore-context, codegraph-prompt, project-notebook-*, merge-forward, native-clock-guard, bmad-loop-relay, hub-selftest. Drop nanoleaf, orca, zellij, claude-notify, ASM and the automaticai Codex rows. Add hindsight-* only if he deploys Hindsight. A per-host overlay (HOOK_HUB_REGISTRY env) is cleaner than editing the shared file.
(6) Candybar systemd-kind jobs (bloodbank-agent-hooks-health, hindsight-capture-sweep) need runner kind `exec` on macOS.
(7) Pre-create the external networks (bloodbank-network, candystore-internal, proxy) and the volumes (bloodbank_bloodbank-nats-data, candystore_pgdata). Start JetStream fresh; do not migrate the 4.17GB.
(8) The schemas are self-contained in bloodbank/schemas, validated by `mise run validate:schemas` and `smoketest:schemas`, so Holyfields is not needed.
(9) The running cost-bridge image is not reproducible from the repo (its scratchpad build context is deleted). Irrelevant for Damian, but worth knowing.

Suggested load split for the orchestrator. aai/auto on big-chungus does the source generalizations: sync.py hooks_dir rendering, a handlers.toml host overlay, launchd plist templates next to the systemd ones, env-driven jot_flush KEY_REF and dev-journal recipient, the GIB stream removal, and the deploy.sh paths. It commits and pushes all of these to bloodbank main. Damian's Codex on the Mac does the on-target work: clone the repos into ~/code at main, `mise install`, create the docker networks and volumes, `op inject` the .env files, bring up the platform compose plus ntfy-router, load the launchd agents, run `mise run hooks:deploy`, then acceptance. Acceptance means `mise run smoketest:schemas`, `bb emit --check`, a router log line, a Candystore row at GET 127.0.0.1:8683/events, and a hub receipt on 127.0.0.1:8685.

src.notes:
LIVE TRUTH VS REPO DOCS. The running triplet does not come from candystore/compose.yml. docker inspect labels show project 33god-platform, config /home/delorenj/code/33GOD/33god-platform/compose.yaml (containers candystore 2 weeks, candystore-daprd, candystore-postgres, all healthy; services named candystore-postgres/candystore/candystore-daprd, healthcheck /readyz, external volume candystore_pgdata, depends_on nats-init and dapr-placement). candystore/compose.yml is a divergent second copy (services postgres/candystore/daprd, healthcheck /healthz, own pgdata volume). mise run up/down/logs use compose.yml; deploy:app and migrate:context use the platform file. AGENTS.md still calls compose.yml the deployment entry point. Per the repo's own 'fix the split, not the patch' rule, the Mac should get ONE trimmed compose (core profile: bloodbank-nats, nats-init, dapr-placement, candystore-postgres, candystore, candystore-daprd; no Holocene, no enricher, no proxy) owned jointly with the Bloodbank inventory.

CONTAINER VS SOURCE FOR THIS DOMAIN (answers the user's open question here). Containers earn their keep for Postgres+pgvector, the Dapr sidecar and the app, because the sidecar addresses the app by docker alias and NATS/placement by docker DNS; all images have linux/arm64 manifests. Source checkout earns its keep for the CLI (`uv tool install --editable`) and project:sync (needs host pjangler). The app image needs no node because static/ is tracked.

SUBSCRIPTION. Dapr programmatic subscription: GET /dapr/subscribe -> pubsubname bloodbank-pubsub, topic bloodbank.evt.>, route /events/all; component dapr-components/pubsub.yaml is pubsub.jetstream with natsURL nats://nats:4222, durable candystore-events, queue group candystore, stream BLOODBANK_EVENTS, deliverPolicy all, ackWait 30s. Confirmed live on the NATS monitor (consumer filter bloodbank.evt.>, 0 pending). ONE filter subject only; enumerating subjects silently drops events (ingest.py:15-34 documents the incident). Duplicate ids return 200; malformed events return 200 {status:DROP} and land in dead_letter; NUL bytes are stripped and the original preserved in dead_letter.

RETENTION. NATS side: BLOODBANK_EVENTS max_age 7d (live 604800 s), 1.08M msgs / 4.17 GB. Candystore side: NO retention, TTL or pruning exists anywhere in code or migrations (grep for retention/ttl/prune/purge/DELETE FROM found only project-table cleanups), so Postgres is unbounded: 26 GB after 46 days, 4.76M events, about 103k/day (126,477 in the last 24 h: agent 62k, llm 31k, cron 28k, system 2.6k, audio 1.1k). Damian will generate a fraction of that, but pick a decision up front (accept growth, or add a Candybar prune job later). conftest.py documents that the live DB has no backup in the repo; Damian has nothing to migrate, start empty.

API. Python stdlib http.server (candystore/main.py), container port 3001 published 127.0.0.1:8683, unauthenticated by design (loopback only). /healthz and /readyz return 204 with empty body, not 200 JSON. Routes: /dapr/subscribe, POST /events/all, /events (q free-text via pg_trgm, filters cli/project/scope/from/to/correlationid/type), /events/:id, /events/:id/summary, /events/:id/raw, /sessions/:id, /sessions/:id/summary, /context/latest, /projects, /lenses, /classes, /summary/{timeline,heatmap,daily,by-cli,by-project}. Port 8683 is hardcoded in bloodbank hook-hub (concerns.py:266), CLI default (cli.py:17), holocene and holocene inbox-watcher; keep it.

SCHEMA TRAPS. init_schema() replays all 10 migrations on every app boot (no ledger, CANDYS-24), so every migration must stay idempotent. Migration 003 enables pg_trgm and 010 enables vector, both need superuser, so a plain postgres:16 image fails boot at 010 even if the enricher is dropped; use pgvector/pgvector:pg16 and keep POSTGRES_USER as the superuser. Tests truncate events/event_embeddings/dead_letter: only run them against CANDYSTORE_TEST_DATABASE_URL on a disposable DB (the fixture guards, but db.py's default URL is the live DB).

PROJECT RESOLUTION. Events carry working_directory, not project. projects.py matches the directory against pjangler repo_path by longest prefix with a '/' boundary (R1) and sibling worktrees whose token starts with the board prefix (R2); nothing Linux-specific, so /Users/damian/code/<repo> works as long as pjangler registered it. The app auto-places new directories at ingest (place_work_dir) but only against the already-synced projects table, so run `python -m candystore.projects` once right after pjangler registers repos, then let Candybar run it hourly at minute 5 UTC.

BRING-UP ORDER ON THE MAC. 1) Bloodbank substrate: bloodbank-network, nats, nats-init (verify stream BLOODBANK_EVENTS), dapr-placement. 2) candystore-postgres, candystore, candystore-daprd. 3) `mise run cli:install` (uv tool install --editable; confirm ~/.local/bin/candystore is first on PATH). 4) After pjangler registry exists: one manual project:sync, then register the Candybar exec manifest and prove a terminal invocation. 5) Verify: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8683/dapr/subscribe; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3504/v1.0/metadata; publish a test CloudEvent and curl 'http://127.0.0.1:8683/events?limit=3'; NATS :8222/jsz shows consumer candystore-events with 0 pending; `candystore context latest --project <slug>` returns without error.

SMALL OBSERVATIONS. GET /events/<non-UUID>/raw raises psycopg2 InvalidTextRepresentation (500 trace in the app log; hook-hub probes it with 'local-…' session ids) - harmless noise, a 400/404 would be cleaner. Dapr log lines 'DROP status returned from app' are expected. candystore/mise.toml has no [tools]; Python is 3.11 in the image, 3.12.10 in the repo .venv and 3.14 as the global mise python here, so pin python=3.12 and uv in a Mac mise.toml. runtime.how: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml up -d --build. Image built locally from Dockerfile (python:3.13-slim, uv sync --frozen from uv.lock, libpq5). Entrypoint runs `alembic upgrade head` then `candybar daemon --roles heartbeat,dispatcher,api`. Env: NATS_URL=nats://nats:4222, DATABASE_URL (op-injected deploy/.env), CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT="". Joins external networks `proxy` and `bloodbank-network`. docker inspect: Privileged=false, bind mount /home/delorenj/candybar/jobs:ro, ExtraHosts host.docker.internal:host-gateway, healthy 6 days.
runtime.why: Evidence it is portable: nothing in it touches the host. cgroup scoping is disabled (compose.yml sets CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT empty), it is not privileged (the Dockerfile comment saying privileged is stale), and the jobs mount only lets the API validate legacy `entrypoint` files, which Mac manifests will not use. Docker earns its keep here for two reasons: the entrypoint auto-migrates the registry, and the control plane stays up when the host executor restarts. This also mirrors Jarad's topology, so the candybar skill and runbooks stay valid. Needs a compose.mac.yml override: drop the external `proxy` network (compose fails if it is missing), the Traefik labels and the jobs mount. Optionally add a postgres service. Keep `bloodbank-network` and `nats:4222`. Fallback if Docker is unwanted: run the same `--roles heartbeat,dispatcher,api` natively under launchd after `alembic upgrade head`.

runtime.how: User unit linked from deploy/host/. ExecStart is deploy/host/run-executor.sh, which execs `<repo>/.venv/bin/candybar daemon --roles executor`. Delegate=yes and DelegateSubgroup=main give per-invocation cgroup v2 scopes under /sys/fs/cgroup for memory.peak and cpu.stat metering. EnvironmentFile=~/.config/candybar/executor.env (rendered DATABASE_URL, mode 600). Env: NATS_URL=nats://localhost:4222, CANDYBAR_WORK_ROOT=%t/candybar/work, CANDYBAR_EXECUTOR_METRICS_HOST=0.0.0.0 and PORT=8701, PATH=.venv/bin:mise shims:~/.local/bin:~/.cargo/bin:/usr/*. Durable `candybar-executor-invoke` on BLOODBANK_COMMANDS (filter bloodbank.cmd.cron.candybar.invoke). Schema guard waits until the registry alembic head equals the checkout head. Live now: 84 registered candybars (80 enabled), runner kinds systemd 65, exec 8, hermes 7, entrypoint 3, n8n 1. Journal shows success lines through 05:56 today.
runtime.why: It must run on the host because jobs need ~/, op, mise, docker, the hermes CLI and the Obsidian vault paths (unit header comment). Scoping is explicitly best-effort: runner.py:186-212 falls back to unscoped with a warning, and run-executor.sh:5-8 says it degrades to unscoped and memory/CPU meter 0, with execution never depending on it. spawn uses start_new_session and killpg, which are POSIX and work on macOS. Mac conditions: (1) set CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT="" in the plist. This silences the per-run warning and skips run-executor.sh:15, which reads /proc/self/cgroup and would abort under `set -e` on macOS. (2) Use launchd only as a supervisor (RunAtLoad + KeepAlive), never StartInterval or StartCalendarInterval, because AGENTS.md bans launchd intervals. (3) Write PATH explicitly with the repo .venv/bin, ~/.local/share/mise/shims, ~/.local/bin and /opt/homebrew/bin, since launchd does not expand ~. (4) Set CANDYBAR_EXECUTOR_METRICS_HOST=127.0.0.1. (5) Install libpq (brew) and set DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH, because psycopg 3.3.6 is the pure-python wheel and dlopens libpq. (6) A headless launchd agent cannot use biometric 1Password, so supply OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN, or wrap ProgramArguments in `op run --env-file ... --`. That avoids the plaintext DSN file that install.sh writes. (7) Run all job env through exec runners, because the systemd runner does not exist on macOS.

src.notes:
DECISION SUMMARY. Do not containerize the whole thing and do not port the systemd layer. The right Mac shape is hybrid, which is what Jarad already runs. The control plane (heartbeat + dispatcher + api) is a Docker container that migrates the registry on boot. The executor is a native launchd agent running from the repo .venv, because jobs need the host. The systemd runner and the unit-holder have no Mac equivalent, so on the Mac every job is an `exec` runner (or hermes/n8n). The systemd coupling is therefore confined to one runner kind and to Jarad's 65 migrated unit-backed jobs. The core fire path (NATS tick -> dispatcher -> invoke command -> executor spawn with start_new_session, AD-8 env and result file -> registry -> events) is pure POSIX Python.

SYSTEMD COUPLING, VERIFIED. (1) Firing: exec jobs are asyncio subprocesses of the executor with a private process group (runner.py:318). systemd jobs are `systemctl --user start --wait <unit>` (systemd_runner.py:469) with a generated per-unit drop-in ~/.config/systemd/user/<unit>.d/50-candybar.conf and the holder drop-in. No transient units or systemd-run are used. (2) Metering: cgroup v2 scopes under the executor's delegated cgroup; best-effort, so on macOS memory and CPU read 0 and nothing else changes (memory/CPU metrics become useless; optional rusage patch). (3) Live registry mix: 65 systemd, 8 exec, 7 hermes, 3 legacy entrypoint, 1 n8n. The hermes and n8n runners are OS-agnostic (they spawn the hermes CLI or a stdlib webhook client as exec children).

BLOCKERS ON macOS, IN ORDER. (a) `candybar doctor --live` has no macOS collector (scheduling_policy.py:35 REQUIRED includes systemd-user/system and /etc/cron.d) so it exits 2; the repo gate `doctor --repo .` works. Port it before registering scheduling-policy-drift, because the Candybar-only rule is only enforceable if doctor can see launchd. (b) run-executor.sh reads /proc/self/cgroup, so set CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT to empty or patch the guard. (c) psycopg needs libpq on the host executor. (d) The watchdog is a Linux timer and policy forbids launchd intervals; it needs a Jarad-signed exact exception record, and it is the single biggest operational gap (no off-scheduler alert on Damian's clock). (e) steward/notify.py:70 defaults to Jarad's Telegram chat id, so never start the steward, or copy jev-rollup-cadence, token-usage-report or the policy job, without overriding the target. (f) compose.yml declares external network `proxy` that will not exist on the Mac, so `up` fails without the override.

RECOMMENDED INSTALL ORDER. 1) Prerequisites: Bloodbank NATS + streams, Postgres container, Docker running, mise (python 3.14, uv), brew libpq, op + service account. 2) Clone https://github.com/delorenj/candybar to ~/code/33GOD/candybar (it is NOT inside the 33GOD checkout), then `uv sync --frozen` and `uv tool install -e .`. 3) Render the DSN with `op inject` into a mode-600 env file outside the repo, or use `op run`. 4) `docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml -f deploy/compose.mac.yml up -d --build`, then `curl 127.0.0.1:8700/healthz`. 5) Install the launchd executor with CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT empty, NATS_URL=nats://localhost:4222, explicit PATH, metrics bound to loopback, KeepAlive only. 6) Register canaries only: watchdog-canary and deploy-smoke-exec (portable verbatim: `/bin/sh -c true` and a head|tail), then deploy-smoke-n8n once n8n has the canary workflow, and deploy-smoke-hermes with his own job id. Prove them with `candybar run <name> --wait`. 7) Then add real jobs as project candybars in their own repos (`candybar create --no-tui ... --exec ... --disabled`, relative ./ argv resolves against the repo root so no /Users hardcoding), `candybar register`, wait for the first scheduled fire for side-effect jobs, then `candybar resume`. 8) Commit and push the manifests in each owning repo. 9) The deferred pieces (steward, watchdog, doctor --live port) come last.

CARRY SET FOR DAMIAN (convert each from a systemd unit to exec, using the unit's ExecStart): Daily Report clock (dev-journal-nightly 0 6 * * *, dev-journal-ensure-nightly 15 6, dev-journal-reconcile hourly) and the project-rollup clock jev-rollup-cadence (*/10) and activity-report per Damian project (the activity-report@<project> template unit exists, instantiate one candybar per project). HeyMa: wax-calls-sync (*/10; unit runs `~/HeyMa/bin/wax --json calls sync --since 2d`, so exec ~/code/HeyMa/bin/wax), delodocs-inbox-cleanup (*/10, vault + MinIO + Wax), delodocs-wiki-self-tuning-weekly, delodocs-triage-second-pass (hermes delodocs-pm), telnyx-s3-intake only if he has Telnyx. 33GOD plumbing: hindsight-capture-sweep, hindsight-write-probe, hindsight-template-sweep, hindsight-memory-analysis, candystore-project-sync, skillex-hermes-resync, bloodbank-agent-hooks-health, hermes-single-install-guard, holocene-pad-roster, crank-beat and aperture-lane-beat (only with the 33god-pm fleet), bloodbank's two n8n project candybars (if Plane exists) and delonet-n8n-workflows-sync only if his n8n is git-synced. Everything in the cruft list stays behind.

TIMEZONES / CLOCKS. Candybar stores cron in the candybar's own IANA zone (migration 0005), default UTC, and most migrated jobs are America/New_York (Daily Report is explicitly 06:00 Eastern). Ask Damian's zone; the Daily Report's 'yesterday' boundary lives in the report tooling, not Candybar. A Mac that sleeps will miss fires: the dispatcher coalesces gaps into a single misfire run within 24h (AD-6) and logs the earlier ones as misfire_coalesced; prevent sleep on the Mac Studio (`pmset -a sleep 0`, or caffeinate) because the heartbeat is the only clock.

OPERATING NOTES. Upgrade is a pair: rebuild the container first (it migrates), then `launchctl kickstart -k` the executor on the same SHA; the executor's schema guard waits (does not corrupt) if the order is wrong. Wrap this in a `mise run candybar:deploy` task. The CLI default API is 127.0.0.1:8700; set CANDYBAR_API_URL elsewhere. The 84-row registry, invocation history and 4058-line ledger are Jarad's state and must not be copied. The registry-sole-writer design means only the daemon writes Postgres; the CLI and autosync go through the API. The candybar skill and AGENTS.md rule (single clock, never cron/launchd/at/Hermes recurring/n8n Schedule Trigger/sleep loops) travel with the repo and skillex, so Damian's agents will enforce it once doctor can see launchd. Live evidence gathered read-only via systemctl --user cat/status, docker inspect, compose.yml, mise.toml, NATS monitoring :8222/jsz, the candybar API, and the executor journal; `candybar doctor --repo . --live --json` here returned status unknown with 2 bypass violations that are Jarad's system timers (docker-stack-ssbnk-cleanup.timer, tailscale-monitor.timer) and one unknown for the rolled-back newapi-allowances ledger entry. Nothing was modified."

hermes and n8n runners — ok (untested) — OS-agnostic, but each needs its own Damian-owned canary first (his own Hermes job id, his own n8n workflow and webhook).

GPU attribution (executor/gpu.py, nvidia-smi) — ok — silent no-op on Mac. Alembic migration 0004 stays in the chain. Apple GPU accounting does not exist. Audio is not a Candybar dependency, and any audio job needs its own macOS permission and device test.

`candybar doctor --live` — blocker for single-clock enforcement — scheduling_policy.py needs systemd and /etc/cron.d collectors and exits 2 on a Mac. `doctor --repo .` works anywhere. Port a launchd collector (scan LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons for StartInterval and StartCalendarInterval) before claiming the Candybar-only rule is enforceable here.

AD-22 watchdog (candybar-watchdog.timer) — blocker — Linux timer, GNU `date -d`, `systemctl --user`, and Jarad's ntfy helper. A launchd interval would violate policy, so a Mac port needs an exact owner-approved exception record from Jarad (for example launchd:<label>). Defer. Until then there is no off-scheduler dead-man alert on Damian's Mac.

Steward role — defer — needs OpenCode, an AutomaticAI gateway account, Jev, the pjangler registry, mc and Telegram. Its default notify target is Jarad's Telegram chat (notify.py:70). If it is ever started, set CANDYBAR_STEWARD_NOTIFY_TARGET=off first.

Repo shell and mise scripts — needs-port — install.sh uses GNU `sed -i` and the Jarad-only ~/docker/stacks/_lib/op-inject.sh. versioning.sh uses GNU sed ranges. Use `op inject` directly, `sed -i ''`, perl, or gsed. materialize-env.sh is already macOS-aware.

Postgres registry — ok (new instance) — a fresh postgres:17-alpine container is enough, with no extensions or special roles (alembic 0001-0009). Reachable from the container by service name and from the host executor by a loopback published port. Never dump or copy Jarad's registry.

Candybar container itself — ok in principle — non-privileged, no host access, and the entrypoint auto-migrates. The `setpriv` and cgroup block is skipped when CANDYBAR_CGROUP_ROOT is empty. Needs the Mac override described above.

Sleep — needs-port — a sleeping Mac misses fires. The dispatcher coalesces gaps into one misfire run within 24h. Prevent sleep (`pmset -a sleep 0` or caffeinate), because the heartbeat is the only clock. This is Damian's call.

src.notes: VERDICT: Run Hermes natively, not in Docker. The gateway is one long-lived Python process whose terminal and file tools must act on the host's ~/code checkouts, credentials and the local Skillex catalog. The fork already ships launchd support (hermes_cli/gateway_launchd.py; template 70-systemd.sh has a Darwin branch), and none of 33god-platform/compose.yaml models Hermes or Hindsight. Docker earns its keep here only as a fallback DB for Hindsight. The Docker Desktop VM is 7.7 GiB and there is no CUDA (M3 Ultra), which rules out the GPU reranker and argues against containerizing local embeddings. STARTING POINT ON THE MAC (from 33god-platform/aperture/research/damian-native-hermes-33god-migration-2026-10-28.md): - Fork install at ~/.hermes/hermes-agent @20a9721964, config v50. - LaunchAgent ai.hermes.gateway, multiplexing default + aai-team + private-desk with no chat platforms. - Hindsight Studio running natively (io.damian.hindsight-studio, 127.0.0.1:8888) with fresh agent-* banks. - Skillex resync LaunchAgent io.33god.skillex-hermes-resync. - Repos at ~/Code/{flume,hermes-agent-template,skillex}. - Target-local 0600 .env files with no op:// refs, bb-hook off, Bloodbank rows quarantined. So this is an upgrade and conform, not a fresh install. DELTAS AGAINST THE USER'S NEW CONVENTIONS: 1. Secrets. Hindsight's LiteLLM ladder collapses to one direct base_url on the Jev gateway. 3. Paths. Move ~/Code/* to ~/code/33GOD/* (flume, hermes-agent-template, pilot, pjangler as 33GOD submodules) and ~/code/skillex. src.notes:
Inventory of Flume and the agent identity adapter on big-chungus, read-only. My recommendation is to install this domain natively on the Mac, with no Docker. The flume CLI is a host-state mutator and already ships a darwin path: launchctl gateway observation, a python fcntl fallback for flock, Homebrew bash detection, HERMES_FLEET_HOME and HERMES_AGENTS_REGISTRY overrides, all covered by tests/macos-portability-regressions.mjs. Damian's Mac has run flume natively since the 2026-10-28 migration.

**Install sequence**
1. Clone with submodules: `git clone --recurse-submodules git@github.com:delorenj/flume ~/code/33GOD/flume`. It is normally reached as the 33GOD submodule. The Mac needs a GitHub SSH key or an https insteadOf rule.
2. Toolchain:
   - `mise install`: node 24 per the repo's mise.toml.
   - `npm ci && npm run build`, then `ln -s .../packages/flume-hr/dist/index.js ~/.local/bin/flume`.
   - `uv tool install copier`, python3 with PyYAML, Homebrew bash 5, `op`, and `px` on PATH.
3. Host config: run `flume handbook bootstrap`, then hand-edit `~/.config/hermes-agent-template/config.toml` for Damian's vault, Plane, Vox and gateway.
4. Org chart: give Damian his own `~/.hermes/org.yaml`. Do not symlink Jarad's `flume/org/org.yaml`.
5. Verify with `flume handbook validate`, `flume roster` and `flume review`.

**Gotchas**
- **Case-insensitive APFS.** Damian already has `~/Code/{flume,hermes-agent-template,skillex}` from the 2026-10-28 migration. On default APFS, `~/code` and `~/Code` are the same directory, but the new canonical path `~/code/33GOD/flume` is a different location from his top-level `~/Code/flume`. When you move it, re-point:
  - `~/.local/bin/flume`
  - `runtime_scaffold_dir` in the host config
  - fleet.env
  - the skillex resync plist
- **1Password reverses an earlier decision.** The 2026-10-28 migration deliberately put NO `op://` refs on Damian's Mac (0600 .env files). Adopting 1Password reverses that, and also clears one of the two recorded gateway-routing exceptions. But "DeLoSecrets" is hardcoded in about 8 source sites (listed in jarad_specific), so a vault with a different name needs a small flume change: one `[fleet].onepassword_vault` read everywhere. The other blocker is the AutomaticAI provider, host and route list baked into parity/rules.ts.

**The identity adapter**
What it is: `flume identity|access|mail|comment`, plus flume-access.service, the agents-facade Worker, GitHub Apps, and Plane native users checked through px.
- Its live use is canary-level: 69 audit rows, the last on 2026-10-29.
- I-5/FLUME-46 is still open, blocked on the colrerererebot install.
- The running facade predates the 2026-11-06 build.

Recommendation: DEFER it for Damian. It needs his own Cloudflare account, a zone with Email Routing, a Zero Trust team with an Access app and per-employee service tokens, KV and R2, plus GitHub Apps created through a browser manifest flow.

Hard coupling to know about: `flume launch <specialist>` (specialist.ts:361-366 calls employeeAccessEnv, launcher.ts:53-62) REFUSES any employee that lacks an enrolled `company_identity.bindings.cloudflare_access` or an employee-access.yaml. It also requires `op read` of a gateway key named AUTOMATICAI_GATEWAY_KEY. So until identity is set up, Damian's portable specialists must run through the launchd gateway or `hermes --profile`, not `flume launch`, unless flume makes the access env optional. `flume hire`, onboard, roster, review, audit, offboard and retire do not need the identity layer.

**Other drift to know**
- Flume asserts "macOS has no Candybar" (rules.ts:3032) and the handbook forbids launchd intervals, yet the Mac runs the skillex resync as a LaunchAgent. This conflicts with "Candybar as canonical scheduler", so the skillex-resync rule needs a darwin Candybar probe.
- On big-chungus no Candybar manifest or timer runs any flume command. flume-access.service is the domain's only resident unit.
- Two local-only branches (FLUME-76 and FLUME-77, I-9 agent messaging) exist only on big-chungus. They are not needed for Damian but are at risk of loss here.

**Load split.** This domain is small:
- **aai/auto:** the flume source generalizations (vault, mail domain, gateway provider and catalog, the Candybar-on-darwin probe, and the `_base.md` conventions block).
- **Damian's Codex:** the Mac-side install, a fresh org.yaml, his workforce definitions, and later, if he opts in, the Cloudflare identity setup.

runtime.unit: waxd.service (user unit, enabled, active) running /home/delorenj/HeyMa/bin/waxd -> components/wax/bin/waxd
runtime.how: Single owner of record, archive, transcribe, enrich: parent of the ffmpeg encoder and of worker threads (inbox, passes, 900 s sweep, 120 s document scan, 10 s outbox drain, 15 s transcripts tick), unix socket var/waxd.sock, ledger var/wax.db (SQLite WAL). Env in the unit: WAX_SEGMENT_SECONDS=60, WAX_DIARIZATION=1, WAX_DIARIZATION_DEVICE=cuda, WAX_TRANSCRIBE pinned absolute, WAX_TRANSCRIPTS_* DSNs, WAX_S3_ENDPOINT. Python is /usr/bin/python3 with apt psycopg and python3-gi.
runtime.ports: unix socket var/waxd.sock only; talks out to NATS 4222, Postgres 5432, Ollama 11434, pj registry 8764, S3
runtime.why: Pure Python stdlib + ffmpeg + pactl, so the daemon logic ports; the blockers are mechanical and enumerated in linux_only (pulse capture, systemd-run scope, /proc identity, renameat2, notify-send, GTK tray, systemctl-based env discovery in bin/wax:166,216). The tray already self-disables without DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY (tray_process.py:47) so headless is supported. Run from the checkout on a mise Python (3.12/3.13) with PyYAML, jsonschema, psycopg[binary] (resolves for arm64), launched by a LaunchAgent with ExitTimeOut large enough to quiesce a capture. Phase 1 can ship without capture (transcribe+enrich of inbox files) and phase 2 adds avfoundation capture.

runtime.unit: bin/transcribe -> scripts/transcribe.py (ASR step spawned by waxd as `nice -n 15 <transcribe> <audio> --no-diarization --asr-output ...`)
runtime.how: faster-whisper default model large-v3, beam_size=5, vad_filter=True, CUDA float16 when >=5 GB VRAM free else CPU int8, loads cuDNN via LD_LIBRARY_PATH, one item at a time under flock, output one stdout line (markdown path). Box: RTX 3090 24 GB. Local branch only when `hostname == big-chungus`, otherwise it ssh/scp's the audio to a remote host.
runtime.why: CTranslate2 (ctranslate2 4.8.x resolves for macOS arm64) has no Metal backend, so faster-whisper on a Mac Studio is CPU int8 only. The single seam to swap is load_whisper (scripts/transcribe.py:260-293) and run_whisper (:296-345), whose consumers need segments with start/end/text plus info.language/duration/language_probability. Recommended Mac backend: mlx-whisper (0.4.3 resolves for arm64) with large-v3-turbo, with silero VAD pre-pass because MLX has no vad_filter and the sanity gate (sanity.py) fails closed on duration mismatch. whisper.cpp (Metal/CoreML) is the CLI alternative; sherpa-onnx Parakeet (already in Vinyl, 2.0.1 arm64 wheel resolves) is a zero-new-dependency fallback. No benchmark was run on a Mac; these are code and wheel-availability findings.

runtime.how: NVIDIA Sortformer nvidia/diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2 over whole file, then per-word attribution by torchaudio forced alignment. WAX_DIARIZATION=1 means required, WAX_DIARIZATION_DEVICE=cuda is strict. install-diarization and `wax doctor` run a real CUDA forward pass as proof.

src.notes:
DECISION SUMMARY. Wax is a native Python daemon on the Mac (launchd, run from a ~/code checkout), never a container: it needs the mic, a same-filesystem inbox and local files, and Docker on Mac has no Metal or CoreAudio. Vinyl is already shipped for macOS as a thin client (macos installer, Homebrew formula, HeyMa.app cask) and its `serve` engine is CPU-only sherpa-onnx, so run serve plus client both on the Mac Studio over 127.0.0.1 (smoke-test `vinyl serve` and `vinyl doctor` on arm64 first; only wheel resolution was verified here). Vox is a fleet server on big-chungus; Damian is a client of https://vox.delo.sh with his own VOX_API_KEY (voxxy CLI + the existing launchd listen plist, afplay path already coded). Local TTS engines are CUDA containers and should be dropped on Mac. Earshot, Holocene whisper/inbox, Telnyx/n8n, vinyl-live, VocaLinux whisper, vibevoice and the retired ~/code/HeyMa are cruft for him.

BLOCKERS IN ORDER (found by reading code, none were run on a Mac): (1) archive.py:49-51 hardwires S3 alias delo, bucket recordings and /usr/local/bin/mc, and the worker stops on archive failure, so no recording is transcribed without a reachable S3 target, so env-ify these and provide a Damian-scoped bucket or local MinIO. (2) bin/transcribe:27,179,356 treats any host not named big-chungus as remote and scp's audio to a hard-coded LAN IP (:28), so set TRANSCRIBE_HOSTNAME or fix the default before the first run. (3) The enabled clipboard-copy pass calls wl-copy/paplay/run-user-1000 and fails every transcript on Mac. (4) 25 files use #!/usr/bin/python3. (5) rename.py has no darwin syscall number (macOS uname is arm64) so every inbox move raises. (6) bin/wax discovers daemon pid and env through systemctl and /proc, so `wax doctor` and `wax status` are blind or false on Mac. (7) title-slug needs obsops frontmatter map, `frontmatters` CLI and the pj registry.

APPLE SILICON TRANSCRIPTION. faster-whisper/CTranslate2 resolves for arm64 but is CPU-only there; the 3090 CUDA float16 path is why big-chungus is fast. Recommend mlx-whisper large-v3-turbo behind the single seam scripts/transcribe.py load_whisper/run_whisper, add silero VAD (Vinyl ships silero_vad.onnx) since vad_filter=True is relied on and the sanity gate fails closed on duration mismatch, and keep ffprobe-derived duration. Alternatives in order: sherpa-onnx Parakeet (already in Vinyl), whisper.cpp with Metal/CoreML. Diarization is the harder gap: Sortformer is CUDA-strict (no mps in the device whitelist, CUDA smoke is the doctor proof, install-diarization smoke-tests CUDA). nemo-toolkit[asr] 2.7.3 resolves for arm64 and torch 2.13.0 needs macOS 14+, but nothing ran. Ship phase 1 with WAX_DIARIZATION=0, then evaluate CPU Sortformer.

COREAUDIO vs PIPEWIRE. Wax capture is ffmpeg `-f pulse` (capture.py:62) with pactl preflight (state.py); Mac equivalent is `-f avfoundation -i ":<n>"`, keeping the segment-muxer crash-safety and the stdin-FIFO 'q' stop. Replace the systemd-run scope with a detached session, procutil /proc identity with ps/sysctl, and renameat2 with renamex_np. Capturing the other side of a meeting needs BlackHole/ScreenCaptureKit, which is why vinyl-live and its PipeWire null sinks are dropped. Vinyl already uses PortAudio/CoreAudio via sounddevice, plus osascript and pbcopy injection.

PACKAGING. Three Linux debs exist (vinyl 0.4.1 installed, 0.4.3 built; vinyl-client; wax 0.1.2 /opt/wax, stale). None applies on Mac: Vinyl uses packaging/macos/install.sh or brew install delorenj/tap/vinyl-client plus the HeyMa.app cask; Wax runs from the checkout with a rendered LaunchAgent. Note the live vinyld units run the deb at 0.4.1, not the checkout.

LAYOUT TRAP. Defaults assume the checkout IS the runtime root at ~/HeyMa (paths.py:12-17 WAX_ROOT, vinyl dictionary.py:166, VINYL_DICTIONARY_LIB derived from it). src.notes:
Recommendation in one line: run n8n natively on the Mac under launchd, start it with a fresh database, and import only a curated set of workflow JSONs. Wax passes run natively with a mise Python. Defer or drop the curator chain and the enricher.

1) Building n8n on the Mac.
   - Never copy ~/.n8n/database.sqlite or ~/.n8n/config. The credentials are encrypted with Jarad's key, and the database is 770MB plus 4.4G of binaryData.
   - Restore through 'n8n import:workflow --input=workflows/<slug>--<id>.json'. IDs are kept, so candybar webhooks and pinned release IDs line up. Use the .published.json where one exists.
   - Recreate the six named credentials by hand from Damian's vault first, then re-bind them.
   - Keep set, with packages and credentials:
     - core-33god: candybar canary, Plane -> Bloodbank, Plane Ingress Reconcile, Ticket Grooming, Ticket Delegation, Groomed in Todo, Ticket Pickup Chip, Lifecycle Lane Errors. Packages: bloodbank, ntfy-client. Credentials: Plane API, n8n API, ntfy.
     - daily-report: Dev Journal (Bloodbank Ingress, Process Reports, Incident Outbox, Calendar Rollups, 07:00 Partial Mail). Packages: bloodbank. Credentials: Dev Journal NewAPI, Plane API, Resend. Coordinate with the Daily Report domain.
     - heyma: Transcription Notifications (apply the HeyMa release.py shape directly, since big-chungus still runs the unreleased 4-node version) and, optionally, AAI Meeting Audio. Import the Wax Transcription and Wax Documents Standard drafts as inactive authoring surfaces only. Packages: heyma, ntfy-client, bloodbank.
   - Everything else in INDEX.md is in the cruft list.
   - Required env: N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false and NODES_EXCLUDE='' (executeCommand and $env), plus KREBS_FENCED_BOARDS and CANDYSTORE_URL.
   - Restart by relaunching ('env -i ... pm2 start'). Never use 'pm2 restart' or 'reload --update-env': they merge the shell's secrets into dump.pm2 in plain text.

2) n8n version clash. Damian already runs n8n 2.44.4, and the Aperture G2 container runs 1.120.4. Pick one native instance before starting: either adopt 2.44.4 after the n8n-nodes-heyma nativeLoader test and the bloodbank node tests pass against it, or install 2.18.4 for parity. Do not run three.

3) Naming: 'enrichment passes' means Wax passes.d in HeyMa. n8n is only an authoring and preview adapter for them. The 33god-platform 'enricher' container is unrelated: an embedding sink with no reader (486k rows). It belongs to Candystore, and I recommend skipping it.

4) Porting the Wax passes.
   - Hardcoded /home/delorenj/HeyMa defaults in the HeyMa nodes and the generator break Damian's ~/code/HeyMa convention. Fix them upstream with env fallbacks (WAX_BIN, WAX_ROOT) and a regenerate. This is a good repo-side patch for aai/auto.
   - The 6 pass bins hardcode op://DeLoSecrets UUID fallbacks. Damian needs refs from his own vault, injected through env or a WAX_PASSES_DIR overlay.
   - Mac blockers:
     - Python 3.9 at /usr/bin/python3 (Wax needs 3.11 or later).
     - wl-copy/paplay in clipboard-copy.
     - CUDA-only diarization: disable it; operator_disabled is not a failure.
     - evdev/gi in the wax entrypoint (the HeyMa domain owns this).
   - Re-import transcript-standard v12 and doc-standard v10 from examples/*-release.json, never from the editor drafts, which are missing dictionary-correction and project-extraction.

5) Publish-before-sourcing gaps:
   - ~/code/obsops holds the only copy of frontmatter-category-map.json, which title-slug needs. It is not in git and not in Syncthing.
   - n8n-nodes-folder-curator, n8n-nodes-pdf-markdown and pdf2md have no remote. All three are curator-only, so they are droppable.
   - The bloodbank checkout sits on feat/bb-34-ntfy-router-tolt-cutover, not main. Build the node from main.

6) Problems on big-chungus itself, outside the migration, worth flagging to Jarad:
   - curator-serve (PID 5122, :8787) is serving a deleted curator.py. ~/.local/bin/folder-curator points at /home/delorenj/code/DeLoDocs/_vault/scripts/curator.py, which no longer exists. It will die on its next restart.
   - The sync-jim-dropbox Candybar job fails every 10 minutes with exit 2.

7) Execution split:

RECOMMENDATION. Damian should be a client of Jarad's MinIO and own a fresh vault. Do not run MinIO on the Mac, and do not sync or clone DeLoDocs. No Docker is needed for this domain on the Mac, so it is not an input to the Docker Desktop versus headless question.

TIME-ORDERED INSTALL FOR DAMIAN
1. Make obsops a real repo first: git init in ~/code/obsops, add a .gitignore (skip _recovered*, Archive, attachments, __pycache__), commit, create delorenj/obsops, push. It has no git, no remote and no backup today, and Wax's title-slug pass depends on it (title-slug.yaml:17). Without it Wax silently skips the frontmatter stamp (the doctor has a probe for this). Alternative: move frontmatter-category-map.json into the HeyMa repo and drop the cross-repo dependency.
2. Mac tooling through mise: mc (aqua:minio/mc), op, uv, node, python. Obsidian via brew --cask.
3. Mint Damian's MinIO service account on big-chungus. Suggested policy 'damian-mac': (a) s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::projects and s3:GetObject/PutObject on projects/*, because html-artifact-delivery uploads to projects/{slug}/{session}/{artifact}/ and public read is already granted by the bucket policy; (b) full RW on new buckets damian-recordings and damian-attachments, created ahead of time with mc mb. Store it as a 1Password item, referenced from his .env.op as MC_HOST_delo. Use the alias name 'delo', because five consumers hardcode it.
4. Seed Damian's vault, not Jarad's. Minimum skeleton: Inbox/, Inbox/Wax/, Transcripts/, Reports/, Projects/, Journal/, Notes/, Ideas/, Domains/, Sandbox/, plus Settings/frontmatter-category-map.json from obsops. Create a symlink ~/d to the vault, because Wax and the daily-report tooling default to ~/d/Transcripts, ~/d/Inbox and ~/d/Sandbox (paths.py:37, hygiene.py:74). Set OBSIDIAN_VAULT, VAULT and ZV through mise [env]. Keep a .stignore only if Damian syncs the vault.
5. Wax changes owned by the Wax domain but forced by this one: make bucket and alias configurable (archive.py:49-51), replace the /home/delorenj path in doc-standard.yaml:15, replace /usr/local/bin/mc with shutil.which, and swap WAX_DIARIZATION_DEVICE=cuda.

HOW TRANSCRIPTS LAND IN THE VAULT (live, verified)
waxd (~/HeyMa) takes audio from inbox/ (hotkey, Syncthing 'audio' folder dropoff, Telnyx S3, manual), uploads and verifies it to s3://recordings/<date>/<sha12>-<name> through mc alias delo (backup-first, never delete), transcribes with faster-whisper large-v3 plus Sortformer diarization on cuda, then writes a markdown note to WAX_VAULT = ~/d/Transcripts = ~/code/DeLoDocs/Transcripts (741 notes, newest 2026-11-09, named YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<title-slug>.md). Frontmatter carries the vault contract (schema-version, asset-kind: transcript, specialist, pipeline-status, category fields, plus source-audio, wax-item-id and wax: provenance). Notes dropped into ~/d/Inbox/Wax are enriched in place by the doc-standard pipeline (120 s scan, new arrivals only). Hygiene trashes empty notes in Inbox and Sandbox to <vault>/.trash. A SQLite ledger plus a Postgres 'transcriptions' store (tx schema) track every note version. The vault is plain files; there is no git and no API.

BUCKET MAP (25 buckets, 18 GiB; one drive, EC:0, no versioning, no lifecycle except earshot's 7-day expiry; same NVMe as the originals; root partition 93% full)
projects (1.1 GiB, anonymous GET; html-artifact-delivery) - Damian: write. recordings (12 GiB; Wax archive) - Damian: own bucket. delodocs-attachments (35 MiB; inbox_cleanup upload-delete) - Damian: own bucket only if the cleanup job is revived. daily-reports (7 MiB; mirror of Reports) - defer. builds (2 GiB, anonymous GET; mobile-deploy-hub) / earshot / earshot-replies / holocene-auto / excalidraw / artcraft-* / the rest - other domains, no Mac need.
Cloudflare's 100 MB request cap applies to the public hostname (compose.yml:15 comment). mc cp uses multipart, so large Wax uploads should pass, but run one 300 MB upload from the Mac before trusting it. Wax allows files up to 300 MB.

runtime.how: `mise run up` = `op run --env-file .env.op -- docker compose up -d --wait`. Image ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-stable (resolves to LiteLLM 1.106.2; the 1.94.0 digest that Hindsight uses has no /typesafe pass-through). The config has no model_list. The /typesafe/* pass-through injects TYPESAFE_API_KEY on the server side, and LITELLM_MASTER_KEY authenticates callers. Up 2 weeks and healthy.
runtime.ports: 4000/tcp inside the container, not published on the host. Reached through Traefik Host(`jev.delo.sh`) (websecure, letsencrypt). External callers come in through the Cloudflare tunnel (*.delo.sh -> traefik:443). On big-chungus itself, /etc/hosts:62 pins jev.delo.sh to 127.0.0.1. There is no tailscale serve entry.
runtime.why: Docker earns its place here. The LiteLLM proxy needs Prisma migrations plus Postgres for virtual keys and spend logs. `docker buildx imagetools` shows main-stable has a linux/arm64 manifest. Change for the Mac: pin the digest of v1.106.2, drop the Traefik labels and the external `proxy` network, publish 127.0.0.1:4000:4000, then run `tailscale serve --bg --https=<port> http://127.0.0.1:4000`, giving https://<mac>.tuxedo-morpho.ts.net[:port]/typesafe/v1/systemone. Containers on the same network should call http://jev-litellm:4000 directly. A native install via pip/uv needs prisma generate plus a Node toolchain plus Postgres, so it is not worth it.

runtime.how: postgres@sha256:3d0f75… (PG 15.18) with a bind mount from /home/delorenj/data/jev-litellm/postgres. Healthy. Holds 8 virtual keys and the spend ledger (LiteLLM_SpendLogs).
runtime.ports: 5432 on the Docker network only, not published
runtime.why: The digest is a multi-arch index that includes linux/arm64/v8 (verified). On macOS, use a named volume instead of a bind mount (avoids virtiofs permission and fsync problems) and the stack's default private network (the shared `proxy` network was only a workaround for Docker address-pool exhaustion on big-chungus). Start Damian with an empty database and mint fresh virtual keys.

runtime.how: User unit, symlinked from ~/.agents/tools/jev-clairic/systemd/. ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/op run --env-file=…/jev-clairic-exporter.env.op -- /usr/bin/python3 %h/.local/bin/jev-clairic-exporter. Active since 2026-10-21. It is a stdlib HTTP server bound to 0.0.0.0:9491. Prometheus job 'jev-clairic' scrapes host.docker.internal:9491. Grafana dashboard uid jev-clairic.
runtime.why: Its jev_key_* gauges read OpenRouter /api/v1/keys/{hash} for the 'OpenRouter API Key - AutomaticAI Jev Classifier' key. That key stopped being the Jev path when traffic moved to the jev-litellm ingress on 2026-10-21 (Choice A), and Damian will not have it. Its jev_calls_1h gauge also undercounts (see the vendor_of bug in notes). Rewrite it to read LiteLLM /key/list or /spend/logs, or the Postgres ledger, before porting. Once rewritten it would run as a native launchd LaunchAgent (stdlib python, `op run` wrapper, needs OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN because launchd cannot use biometric unlock). host.docker.internal works natively on macOS Docker, so the extra_hosts line is unnecessary.

A Mac peer = pgvector container + hindsight container + CLI; everything else is optional. (2) LLM config is fully env-driven (HINDSIGHT_API_LLM_PROVIDER=openai + BASE_URL + per-role model aliases), so pointing at jev.delo.sh directly makes the litellm container and its 4-rung ladder unnecessary on the Mac — aligns with user request #2 (mint Damian a nonexpiring jev key; that mint is a separate action item in the AutomaticAI gateway, see stacks/ai/newapi/ops/gateway-tokens.py pattern). (3) GPU reranker is already optional by design: RERANKER_PROVIDER=local is the built-in failover, measured 2.6-9.4s per 300-candidate rerank vs 22-33ms on TEI — fine for a single-user Mac. (5) The deterministic agent memory flow on big-chungus is bb-hook (symlink into ~/.agents/hooks) -> hook-hub daemon over a unix socket -> Hindsight API; bank resolution = .hindsight/bank file > HINDSIGHT_BANK env > origin repo name > main-checkout basename (worktree-safe via --git-common-dir) > CWD basename > 'general'.
